releases.name: PapeRuss 2.0 Stabilization
releases.title: Reliability, Reminder, Security, and PWA Stabilization
releases.body:
### PapeRuss 2.0 Stabilization
- Fixed the changelog parse error and added release validation.
- Repaired calendar recurrence and reminder persistence.
- Made notification switches and test results reliable.
- Added sanitization for imported, pasted, local, and cloud note content.
- Normalized task, settings, cover, and notification records.
- Aligned and hardened the PWA cache at paperuss-shell-v21.

**Reminder limitation:** alerts are checked while PapeRuss is open; closed-app push delivery is not included.

releases.name: PapeRuss 2.0 Official Release
releases.title: Major Feature Release & Improvements
releases.body:
### What's New in PapeRuss 2.0
- **Block & Rich Text Editor**: Enhanced formatting, table insertion, drag-and-drop media, slash commands, and block handles.
- **Cloud Sync & Firebase Auth**: Cross-device synchronization with complete offline fallback and local IndexedDB media storage.
- **Attachment & Scroll Fixes**: Smooth note navigation, auto-scroll containment, and resilient offline attachment caching.
- **Task & Activity Hub**: Centralized notifications, due-task alert banners, completion chimes, and reminder scheduling.
- **Theme & Accent Customization**: Vibrant dark/light modes and customizable accent themes.
- **Data Backup & Clearing**: Portability tools to export/import backups and clear local offline cache safely.
